mapper.select: SELECT poet_id, name, pen_name, gender, birth_year, death_year, nationality, biography FROM poet ORDER BY poet_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poet WHERE poet_id = #{poetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poet (name, pen_name, gender, birth_year, death_year, nationality, biography) VALUES (#{name}, #{penName}, #{gender}, #{birthYear}, #{deathYear}, #{nationality}, #{biography})
mapper.update: UPDATE poet SET name = #{name}, pen_name = #{penName}, gender = #{gender}, birth_year = #{birthYear}, death_year = #{deathYear}, nationality = #{nationality}, biography = #{biography} WHERE poet_id = #{poetId}
